rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Gift Card Balance Probing Velocity Detection")`
`comment("NRF FT1103: Monitor balance check endpoints for automated probing")`
index=retail sourcetype=giftcard:balance_check
| bin _time span=1h
| stats count AS check_count,
        dc(card_number) AS unique_cards,
        dc(user_agent) AS unique_agents,
        values(device_fingerprint) AS devices
  BY source_ip, _time
| where check_count > 50 OR unique_cards > 20
| eval risk = case(
    check_count > 200 AND unique_cards > 100, "CRITICAL",
    check_count > 100 OR unique_cards > 50, "HIGH",
    check_count > 50 OR unique_cards > 20, "MEDIUM"
  )
| sort - check_count
rules.title: DL-0144: Gift Card Balance Probing Velocity Detection (SPLUNK)

rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Gift Card Merge and Transfer Anomaly Detection")`
`comment("NRF FT1202: Monitor for suspicious multi-card merges")`
index=retail sourcetype=giftcard:transactions
  transaction_type IN ("merge", "transfer", "consolidate")
| stats count AS merge_count,
        dc(source_card) AS source_card_count,
        sum(transfer_amount) AS total_transferred,
        min(_time) AS first_merge,
        max(_time) AS last_merge,
        values(source_ip) AS source_ips
  BY destination_card
| eval window_minutes = round((last_merge - first_merge) / 60, 1)
| where source_card_count >= 3 AND window_minutes < 60
| sort - source_card_count
rules.title: DL-0145: Gift Card Merge and Transfer Anomaly Detection (SPLUNK)
